entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Hi, you've reached VeloFit. My name is Sarah. How can I help you today?
I need to return a VeloBand.
I can certainly look into that for you. May I have your name and order number, please?
Alex Chen. Order 774-B-91.
Thank you, Alex. I have your account pulled up. Just to understand the situation better, what specifically is the issue with the VeloBand? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference issue?
Preference. I tried to return it weeks ago, but your website decided not to work.
I'm very sorry to hear you had trouble with our return portal. Can you tell me the approximate date you tried to process the return?
It was around December 24th. The whole thing was a mess. A total website error.

Okay, one moment while I check our system logs for that date... Yes, I do see a record of a known outage. Our return portal was flagged as 'system down' for several hours that day. I sincerely apologize for that inconvenience.
Right. I took a screenshot because I knew this would happen. I couldn't print the label or anything. Convenient for you.

I completely understand your frustration, and the screenshot won't be necessary. The system event confirms what you experienced. Let me just review the return eligibility for you. I see you received the item on December 15th.
Okay, looking at our policy here... yes, all our items have a 90-day return window.
So?
So, you are well within that timeframe. I'm processing the return for you right now, and I will email you a pre-paid shipping label immediately.
Fine. About time.

And Alex, I see you're a VIP member with VeloFit. To apologize for the website issue you encountered, I've also added a $25 credit to your account for any future purchase. We do appreciate your business.
Whatever. Just send the label.
The email with the label and confirmation is on its way to you now. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No.
Alright. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a good day.
